scope.purpose: Combined completeness/current-norm audit of five compact Grade-11 government/punctuation identities; no physical bank mutation.

current_academic_crosscheck.source: Gramota.ru — current government reference: согласно + dative

decisions.current_rule: In the normative prepositional constructions represented by this school unit, БЛАГОДАРЯ, СОГЛАСНО and ВОПРЕКИ govern the dative case.
decisions.high_risk_note: For СОГЛАСНО, forms such as согласно договора are nonstandard in the target literary norm; use согласно договору.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep one government family because the learner decision is the same case-governance boundary for the source cluster.

current_model: No lexical preposition in this group independently acts as an automatic comma switch.
Isolation is favored/required by structural interruption, especially when the phrase stands between subject and predicate.
Outside such positions, semantic emphasis, phrase extent, position and closeness to the predicate affect punctuation; non-isolation is often possible.
decisions.patch_policy: Existing context model is accurate; keep punctuation ownership separate from case-government and spelling identities.

decisions.current_model: Concessive circumstances with НЕСМОТРЯ НА / НЕВЗИРАЯ НА are normally isolated. Non-isolation is possible in the narrow case of direct post-verbal/tight predicative integration where the phrase is semantically part of the predicate.
decisions.patch_policy: Strengthen the existing wording: these are not merely generic optional derived-preposition phrases, but a strongly isolated concessive subtype with a documented tight-integration exception. Keep separate from the orthographic НЕСМОТРЯ / НЕ СМОТРЯ identity.

current_model: Punctuation depends on construction meaning and syntactic integration, not the trigger word alone.
КРОМЕ may express exclusion or addition; context remains decisive.
ВМЕСТО must distinguish an inserted replacement/additional construction from a tightly governed object/person replacement or meaning close to за / в качестве.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep one structured school unit with explicit semantic branches; do not turn every preposition into a separate denominator identity.

decisions.current_rule: When two gerund phrases are homogeneous adverbial circumstances attached to the same predicate and joined by a single И, no comma is inserted between the two phrases solely because both are gerund constructions.
decisions.boundary_note: Each full coordinated gerund group may still require isolation from the rest of the sentence under the ordinary gerund rule; this identity decides only the internal comma between the homogeneous turns.

cumulative_audit_progress.note: Audit counters only; not readiness percentages.
